description: ePricing L1 Operations Dashboard — CRMNXT-style. Stat tiles go GREEN/YELLOW/RED. Integration Jobs table pulled from DB — no DB login needed.
title: ePricing L1 Operations Dashboard

panels.title: Total Jobs (DB)
panels.description:
**Cumulative Total Loan Requests in YugabyteDB**

Counts every row stored in `pricing_requests` across all statuses (`CALCULATED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `EXPIRED`, `PENDING`, `ERROR`).

- **Source:** YugabyteDB SQL (`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pricing_requests`)
- **Healthy:** Monotonically rising when traffic or `traffic-generator` is active.
- **Check if abnormal:** If flatlined or zero/erroring, check YugabyteDB container health (`:5433` / `:15433`) and `epricing-service` readiness probe.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Jobs" FROM pricing_requests

panels.title: Enabled Jobs (DB)
panels.description:
**Eligible & Rate-Locked Loans in Pipeline**

Counts rows in `pricing_requests` currently in `CALCULATED` (valid quote issued) or `APPROVED` (rate locked via Temporal signal) status—excluding `REJECTED`, `ERROR`, `PENDING`, and `EXPIRED`.

- **Source:** YugabyteDB SQL (`WHERE status IN ('CALCULATED','APPROVED')`)
- **Healthy:** Growing steadily alongside `Total Jobs (DB)`.
- **Check if abnormal:** If `Total Jobs` grows while `Enabled Jobs` stalls, inspect the *Error & Rejected Jobs* table below for widespread underwriting rejections or DB errors.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Enabled Jobs" FROM pricing_requests WHERE status IN ('CALCULATED','APPROVED')

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description:
**ePricing Service JVM Process CPU %**

Measures CPU share used specifically by the Spring Boot JVM process (`process_cpu_usage * 100`), scraped every 10s from `/actuator/prometheus`.

- **Green:** `< 50%` (healthy headroom)
- **Yellow:** `50% – 80%` (elevated load / GC activity)
- **Red:** `≥ 80%` (`EPricingHighCPU` alert threshold—thread contention & latency spikes likely)
- **Action:** Correlate with `Active In-Flight Requests` and check container CPU throttling in *Container & Node Utilization*.

panels.title: Memory Utilization
panels.description:
**JVM Heap Memory Utilization %**

Ratio of live heap bytes used (`jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap"}`) to bounded max heap (`jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap"} > 0`). Uses `> 0` so G1GC regions reporting `-1` don't skew the percentage.

- **Green:** `< 60%` (normal sawtooth GC recovery)
- **Yellow:** `60% – 85%` (rising heap occupancy)
- **Red:** `≥ 85%` (`EPricingHighHeapUsage` alert threshold—high risk of `OutOfMemoryError`)
- **Action:** Inspect the *JVM Memory — Heap Used vs Max* sawtooth trend in the Complete Observability dashboard.

panels.title: GUI Requests
panels.description:
**Read / Lookup Traffic Volume (All HTTP `GET` Requests in Selected Time Window)**

Total HTTP `GET` requests handled by `epricing-service` during the dashboard time range (`$__range`, e.g. last 30m).

- **Includes:** `GET /api/v1/pricing` (paginated history), `GET /api/v1/pricing/{id}` (quote lookup), `GET /api/v1/workflow/pricing/{id}[/status]` (Temporal status polling), and `GET /api/v1/health/*` probes.
- **Query:** `sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{method="GET"}[$__range]))`
- **Why 'GUI':** Follows the CRMNXT L1 ops template naming for interactive/portal read lookups (`GET`) versus write pricing APIs (`POST`).

panels.title: API Requests
panels.description:
**Core Loan Pricing Write Volume (HTTP `POST` to `/pricing*` in Time Window)**

Total `POST` calls hitting pricing calculation or Temporal rate-lock endpoints during the selected dashboard range (`$__range`).

- **Includes:** `POST /api/v1/pricing` (sync calculation + DB save + Kafka event) and `POST /api/v1/workflow/pricing/start` / `approve` / `reject`.
- **Query:** `sum(increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{method="POST",uri=~".*/pricing.*"}[$__range]))`
- **Check if abnormal:** A drop to `0` during active traffic means upstream callers or `traffic-generator` stopped submitting quotes.

panels.title: Mobile / Other
panels.description:
**Total Service HTTP Traffic Volume (All Methods & Endpoints in Time Window)**

Cumulative count of **all** HTTP requests (`GET`, `POST`, `/pricing`, `/workflow/pricing`, `/health`, `/metrics-demo`) served by `epricing-service` over `$__range`.

- **Query note:** Currently aggregates all `http_server_requests_seconds_count` without filtering to `/actuator` or `/metrics-demo` only, so this value equals overall microservice HTTP volume rather than strictly mobile/actuator calls.
- **Check if abnormal:** `0` indicates no HTTP ingress is reaching port `:8080` at all.

panels.title: GUI (p95 ms)
panels.description:
**Read Endpoint Latency — 95th Percentile (`GET` Requests)**

95% of HTTP `GET` requests (`/pricing`, `/workflow/pricing/{id}`, `/health/*`) finished faster than this value over a 5-minute rolling window (`[5m]`).

- **Green:** `< 500 ms` (target read SLA)
- **Yellow:** `500 ms – 2,000 ms` (slow DB query / pool wait)
- **Red:** `≥ 2,000 ms` (SLA breach)
- **Action:** If elevated, check `DB Blockings` and YugabyteDB CPU.

panels.title: API (p95 ms)
panels.description:
**Core Pricing Write Latency — 95th Percentile (`POST` Requests)**

95% of HTTP `POST` requests (underwriting gates + `BigDecimal` EMI calculation + YugabyteDB commit + Kafka dispatch) completed faster than this value over a 5-minute window (`[5m]`).

- **Green:** `< 500 ms` (typical sync path is `< 50 ms`)
- **Yellow:** `500 ms – 2,000 ms` (degraded persistence or GC pauses)
- **Red:** `≥ 2,000 ms` (`EPricingHighLatency` RBI SLA breach)
- **Action:** Check `DB Connection Acquire Time` and Temporal/Kafka broker reachability.

panels.title: Mobile (p50 μs)
panels.description:
**Internal Diagnostics & Probe Median Latency (p50 in Microseconds)**

50th-percentile (median) response time for `/actuator/*` and `/metrics-demo/*` endpoints over `[5m]`, scaled to microseconds (`* 1,000,000`). Expected to remain elevated briefly if `metrics-demo/simulate-slow` was triggered (`800–1500 ms`).

- **Green:** `< 200,000 µs` (`200 ms`)
- **Yellow:** `200,000 – 500,000 µs` (`200–500 ms`)
- **Red:** `≥ 500,000 µs` (`500 ms+`)

panels.title: GUI (4XX)
panels.description:
**Client Errors on Read Endpoints (`GET` HTTP `4XX` in Time Window)**

Count of `4XX` responses on `GET` requests over `$__range`—most commonly `404 Not Found` (`PRICING_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` on unknown IDs) or `400 Bad Request` (`ARGUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH` on invalid query params).

- **Green:** `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` (review client callers or malformed lookup IDs in Loki `WARN` logs).

panels.title: API (4XX)
panels.description:
**Business Policy Rejections & Validation Errors (`POST` HTTP `4XX` in Time Window)**

Count of `4XX` responses on `POST` calls over `$__range`. Covers both normal banking underwriting denials and invalid schemas:
- **HTTP `422`:** `PRICING_INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT_SCORE` (`< 650`), `PRICING_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBILITY` (`> 10x income`), `PRICING_FOIR_EXCEEDED` (`> 50%` monthly income).
- **HTTP `400`:** `PRICING_VALIDATION_FAILED`, `MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY`, `TEMPORAL_DISABLED`.

- **Action:** Note that `traffic-generator` intentionally sends credit-score `580` (~108s) and excess-loan (~168s) samples; drill into the *Error & Rejected Jobs* table below to verify expected vs unexpected rejections.

panels.title: Mobile (4XX)
panels.description:
**Client Errors on `/actuator` & `/metrics-demo` (`4XX` in Time Window)**

Count of `4XX` responses on management or demo routes over `$__range`.

- **Green:** `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` (note: in `prod` profile `@Profile("!prod")` disables `/metrics-demo`, so hitting those routes returns `404`).

panels.title: GUI (5XX)
panels.description:
**Server Crashes on Read Endpoints (`GET` HTTP `5XX` in Time Window)**

Internal server failures (`500`/`503`) returned by `GET` endpoints—such as YugabyteDB down during `/api/v1/health/readiness` (`503`) or unhandled query exceptions.

- **Green:** Strictly `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` — Immediate investigation in Loki (`level="ERROR"`) and YugabyteDB health check.

panels.title: API (5XX)
panels.description:
**Server Failures on Core Pricing `POST` APIs (`5XX` in Time Window)**

Unhandled server exceptions (`INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` / `PRICING_CALCULATION_FAILED` / `503`) on `POST` pricing or Temporal workflow calls.

- **Green:** Strictly `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` (`P1` / `EPricingHighErrorRate` risk) — Check *Error & Rejected Jobs* table and Loki `ERROR Logs` using the captured `Trace ID`.

panels.title: Mobile (5XX)
panels.description:
**Server Failures on `/actuator` & `/metrics-demo` (`5XX` in Time Window)**

Unhandled `5XX` responses on actuator or demo observability routes over `$__range`.

- **Green:** Strictly `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` — Inspect JVM logs for exception stack traces.

panels.title: Database Health · Connection Pool · Blockings & Long Running Queries
DB Blockings (Transaction)
panels.description:
**HikariCP Pending Threads Waiting for a DB Connection**

Live count of application threads currently blocked waiting to check out a connection from `epricing-pool` (`hikaricp_connections_pending`).

- **Green:** Strictly `0` (connections acquired immediately)
- **Red:** `≥ 1` (`EPricingDBConnectionPoolLow` alert fires after 2m)—pool exhaustion or slow YugabyteDB transactions blocking threads.

panels.title: DB Blockings (Reporting)
panels.description:
**HikariCP Connection Acquisition Timeouts (`epricing-pool`)**

Cumulative count of threads that waited longer than `connection-timeout` (`30,000 ms`) and failed with `SQLTransientConnectionException` (`hikaricp_connections_timeout_total`).

- **Note:** Reads the same `hikaricp_connections_timeout_total` counter as *DB Blocker Count* for the CRMNXT dual-column layout.
- **Green:** Strictly `0` | **Red:** `≥ 1` (severe YugabyteDB contention or connection leak).

panels.title: DB Blocker Count
panels.description:
**Total DB Connection Acquisition Timeouts Since App Start**

Total occurrences of `hikaricp_connections_timeout_total` on `epricing-pool` since JVM startup.

- **Green:** Strictly `0` (no request ever timed out waiting for a DB slot)
- **Red:** `≥ 1` — Inspect YugabyteDB active queries (`pg_stat_activity`) and Hikari leak detection warnings.

panels.title: DB Sleeping Sessions
panels.description:
**Idle Connections Ready in HikariCP Pool (`epricing-pool`)**

Number of open physical YugabyteDB connections currently idle and ready for instant reuse (`hikaricp_connections_idle`). `application.yml` maintains `minimum-idle: 5` by default.

- **Healthy:** `5` during quiet traffic; lower only when active bursts check out connections.

panels.title: DB Logins (Transaction)
panels.description:
**Total Open Connections in HikariCP Pool (`active + idle`)**

Combined active + idle connections currently held open in `epricing-pool` against YugabyteDB.

- **Thresholds (L1 panel):** Green `< 7`, Yellow `7–9`, Red `≥ 10` (configured pool ceiling is `maximum-pool-size: 20` in `application.yml`).
- **Action:** If pinned at ceiling alongside non-zero `Pending`, check for slow queries or long transactions.

panels.title: DB Logins (Reporting)
panels.description:
**Idle Connections Ready in Pool (Reporting Slot Equivalent)**

Mirrors `hikaricp_connections_idle` on `epricing-pool` (ePricing uses one shared YugabyteDB transactional pool rather than a separate reporting DB pool).

- **Healthy:** Typically `5` idle connections at rest.

panels.title: Long Running Query (TXN)
panels.description:
**Technical Pricing Calculation Failures (Last 5 Minutes)**

Increase in `pricing_requests_total{type="failed"}` over `[5m]`. Counts unexpected technical/persistence failures during `PricingService.calculatePricing()` (does **not** count business rejections like low credit score).

- **Green:** Strictly `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` — Open *Error & Rejected Jobs* below or check Loki `level="ERROR"`.

panels.title: Long Running Query (RPT)
panels.description:
**Slow HTTP Requests Exceeding 2.0s SLA (Last 5 Minutes)**

Number of HTTP requests in the last 5m taking longer than `2.0` seconds (`http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} - {le="2.0"}`).

- **Green:** `0`
- **Red:** `≥ 1` — Check whether `/metrics-demo/simulate-slow` (`0.8–1.5s`, normally `< 2s`) or genuine DB/Kafka stalls pushed requests above 2s.

panels.title: Integration Jobs — All Running / Complete / Error (Live from YugabyteDB)
Integration Jobs — All Pricing Requests (Click any row to expand full details)
panels.description:
**Live YugabyteDB Pricing Audit Table (Latest 500 Requests)**

Queries `pricing_requests` directly via the read-only `grafana_reader` PostgreSQL/YSQL connection so L1 support can inspect quotes without SSH/DB CLI access.

- **Statuses:** `CALCULATED` / `APPROVED` (green), `PENDING` (yellow), `REJECTED` (orange), `ERROR` (red).
- **Columns:** IST timestamp (`Asia/Kolkata`), `Duration (ms)`, `Rate %`, `EMI (INR)`, categorized `Error Summary`, raw `Full Error (DB)`, and clickable `Trace ID` (opens distributed trace in Grafana Tempo).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id                                                                  AS "Job ID",
  customer_id                                                         AS "Customer",
  product_type                                                        AS "Product",
  status                                                              AS "Status",
  (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'           AS "Started At",
  processing_time_ms                                                  AS "Duration (ms)",
  calculated_rate                                                     AS "Rate %",
  emi_amount                                                          AS "EMI (INR)",
  CASE
    WHEN status IN ('ERROR', 'REJECTED') AND error_message IS NOT NULL
      THEN CASE
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%credit%score%' OR error_message ILIKE '%credit_score%'
          THEN 'Credit score below minimum threshold'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%loan%amount%' OR error_message ILIKE '%loan_amount%'
          THEN 'Loan amount outside permitted range'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%income%'
          THEN 'Income insufficient for requested loan'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%expired%or%aborted%' OR error_message ILIKE '%Transaction%expired%'
          THEN 'DB Transaction conflict — retry required'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%CannotAcquireLockException%' OR error_message ILIKE '%lock%'
          THEN 'DB lock acquisition failed — concurrent write conflict'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%JpaSystemException%'
          THEN 'JPA persistence layer error'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%Connection%'
          THEN 'Database connection failure'
        WHEN error_message ILIKE '%timeout%'
          THEN 'Request timed out'
        ELSE SUBSTRING(error_message FROM 1 FOR 120)
      END
    WHEN status IN ('ERROR','REJECTED') AND error_message IS NULL
      THEN 'Error captured — no message recorded'
    ELSE ''
  END                                                                 AS "Error Summary",
  COALESCE(error_message, '')                                         AS "Full Error (DB)",
  trace_id                                                            AS "Trace ID"
FROM pricing_requests
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: ❌ Error & Rejected Jobs — Root Cause Drill-Down (Live from DB)
Error & Rejected Jobs — Root Cause Drill-Down (Live from DB)
panels.description:
**Error & Business Rejection Root-Cause Table (Latest 200 Rows)**

Filtered live SQL view (`WHERE status IN ('ERROR', 'REJECTED')`) from YugabyteDB.

- **How to use:** `Root Cause` classifies common underwriting denials (low credit score, 10x income cap, 50% FOIR) vs technical faults (DB lock/transaction expiration, JPA failure, connection refused, timeout). Click `Trace ID` to jump straight to Tempo spans.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id                                                                  AS "Job ID",
  customer_id                                                         AS "Customer",
  product_type                                                        AS "Product",
  status                                                              AS "Status",
  (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'           AS "Failed At",
  processing_time_ms                                                  AS "Duration",
  CASE
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%credit%score%' OR error_message ILIKE '%credit_score%'
      THEN '❌ Credit score below minimum threshold'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%loan%amount%' OR error_message ILIKE '%loan_amount%'
      THEN '❌ Loan amount outside permitted range'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%income%'
      THEN '❌ Income insufficient for requested loan'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%expired%or%aborted%' OR error_message ILIKE '%Transaction%expired%'
      THEN '⚠️ DB Transaction conflict — YugabyteDB lock expired (retry safe)'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%CannotAcquireLockException%'
      THEN '⚠️ Concurrent write conflict — lock acquisition failed'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%JpaSystemException%'
      THEN '⚠️ JPA persistence layer error — check DB integrity'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%Connection%' OR error_message ILIKE '%connection refused%'
      THEN '🔴 Database connection failure'
    WHEN error_message ILIKE '%timeout%'
      THEN '🔴 Request timed out — SLA breach'
    WHEN error_message IS NULL
      THEN '⚠️ Error recorded but no message captured'
    ELSE CONCAT('⚠️ ', SUBSTRING(error_message FROM 1 FOR 150))
  END                                                                 AS "Root Cause",
  COALESCE(error_message, 'No error message stored in DB')           AS "Full Stack (DB)",
  trace_id                                                            AS "Trace ID"
FROM pricing_requests
WHERE status IN ('ERROR', 'REJECTED')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
